units.source_text: 大女公子想：“我昨天对薰中纳言戏作了总角之歌，恐怕妹妹以为我昨夜有心和他‘相隔约寻丈’而对晤吧？”

en.t: The elder princess thought, "Yesterday I jokingly composed that agemaki poem for Kaoru, the Middle Counselor; perhaps my sister thinks I deliberately met him last night, facing him from only about ten feet away?"

units.source_text: 觉得十分可耻，便托辞“心情不佳”，恹恹地病了一天。

en.t: Feeling terribly ashamed, she made the excuse that she was unwell and spent the whole day languidly ill.

units.source_text: 侍女们说：“周年忌辰没有几天就到了。

en.t: The ladies-in-waiting said, "The first anniversary memorial day is only a few days away.

units.source_text: 那些零零星星的事情，除了大小姐以外没有人能好好地办理。

en.t: No one but the elder young lady can properly take care of all those small, scattered preparations.

units.source_text: 偏巧她又在这时候生病了。”

en.t: And just at such a time, she has fallen ill."

units.source_text: 二女公子正在编制香几上的流苏，她说：“流苏上的饰花我不会做。”

en.t: The younger princess was braiding the tassels for the incense stand, and she said, "I do not know how to make the decorative flowers for the tassels."
She insisted that the elder princess must make them.

units.source_text: 此时房中光线阴暗，没人看见，大女公子便坐起来，和她两人同做。

en.t: At that moment the room was dim and no one could see her, so the elder princess sat up and worked on them together with her.
